'''Tama Burr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who dealt in bird commerce on [[Recopia]]. Her manor was equipped to meet the needs of a variety of exotic [[Species/Legends|species]]. She had provided numerous rare animals for the [[Abersaith Aviary]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].<ref name="CatCW" />
